dialog.createDescription: Everyone you add to the group will see the notes in it.

delete.title: Delete group?
delete.modeLabel: What happens to the notes in this group
delete.transferDescription_one: {{count}} note will become {{name}}'s personal note. Its address changes to /n/…, and the old address forwards to it for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public link it has is turned off.
delete.transferDescription_other: {{count}} notes will become {{name}}'s personal notes. Their addresses change to /n/…, and the old addresses forward to them for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public links on them are turned off.
delete.transferDescriptionNoCount: The group's notes will become {{name}}'s personal notes. Their addresses change to /n/…, and the old addresses forward to them for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public links on them are turned off.
delete.transferTrashNote: Group notes in the trash go to {{name}}'s personal trash, and their retention period still counts from when they were deleted; their public links are turned off too.
delete.deleteDescription_one: {{count}} note, its attachments and its edit history are permanently deleted — it doesn't go to the trash. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescription_other: {{count}} notes, their attachments and their edit history are permanently deleted — they don't go to the trash. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescriptionNoCount: The group's notes (including those in its trash), their attachments and their edit history are permanently deleted — they don't go to the trash. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescriptionWithTrash_one: {{count}} note (including {{trash}} in the trash), its attachments and its edit history are permanently deleted — it doesn't go to the trash. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescriptionWithTrash_other: {{count}} notes (including {{trash}} in the trash), their attachments and their edit history are permanently deleted — they don't go to the trash. This can't be undone.
delete.acknowledge: I understand the notes will be permanently deleted

leave.title: Leave group?
leave.description: You will lose access to the notes in "{{name}}".

detail.membersDescriptionAdmin: Add people by email. Members see every note in this group.
detail.membersDescriptionMember: Only people whose role can manage members can add or remove members.
detail.lastAdminHint: The only admin can't be demoted or removed. Make someone else an admin first.
detail.dangerDescription: Deleting the group either gives its notes to one of its admins or deletes them with it.

roles.descriptionManage: Each member has one role, and the role decides what they can do. The built-in Admin role can't be changed; the built-in Member role is what new members get, and it can't be renamed or deleted.
roles.descriptionView: Each member has one role, and the role decides what they can do. Only people whose role can manage roles and the group can change these.
roles.readAlways: Every role can read the group's notes, their backlinks and their AI edit history.

create.label: Create
create.description: Create notes in the group, or move or copy a personal note into it. Without Edit, a note you create, move or copy there is read-only for you too.

edit.label: Edit
edit.description: Change the content and title of the group's notes.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: Move the group's notes to the trash. With Edit as well, also restore them from the trash or delete them permanently.

managePublicLink.label: Manage public links
managePublicLink.description: Turn the anonymous public link of the group's notes on and off, and change a note's URL name through the API.

manageMembers.label: Manage members
manageMembers.description: Add and remove people and change their roles — including making anyone, themselves included, an Admin. A group always keeps at least one Admin.

manageGroup.label: Manage roles & group
manageGroup.description: Rename or delete the group, and create, change and delete its roles.

roles.adminLocked: The built-in Admin role always has every permission and can't be changed.

delete.title: Delete role?
delete.description_one: {{count}} member who has this role will become a Member.
delete.description_other: {{count}} members who have this role will become Members.

dialog.title: New role
dialog.description: Name the role and turn on what it allows. You can change both later.

roles.deleteWithoutEditHint: Without Edit, notes deleted with this role can't be restored from the trash by its holders.
